claims.statement: C-PHYS-ME1 is defined by U(phi)=1/2 m_phi^2 phi^2 with m_phi^2>0, Z_F(phi)=1, lambda(phi)=M6^5 tau exp(alpha phi/M6^2) with tau>0 and alpha>0, Z_sigma(phi)=M6^3 z_sigma with z_sigma>0, scalar domain phi/M6^2 in R, and q_ref=1/M6.
claims.validity_regime: The current canonical MD2S-R1-C-PHYS two-disk U(1) minimal Einstein-Maxwell-scalar-plus-cap branch after Freeze-1A.
claims.forbidden_inference: This model definition is not a derivation from observations, C1-V or historical A0 material and does not establish a background solution, stability, identifiability or a release gate.
claims.upgrade_condition: A later versioned block must freeze one benchmark parameter tuple, integer sector and dimensionless normalization before any numerical preflight.

claims.forbidden_inference: A five-parameter accounting result is not a proof of structural or practical identifiability.
claims.upgrade_condition: Construct and rank the governed model-to-residual and later model-to-observable Jacobians under a fixed benchmark instance.
